questions.questionTextEn: If log_2(x) + log_4(x) + log_16(x) = 7, then the value of x is:
questions.questionTextHi:
[Quantitative Aptitude • GATE CSE (CS) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
यदि log_2(x) + log_4(x) + log_16(x) = 7, then का मान x is:
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (GATE CSE (CS) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।

questions.explanationHi:

विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:

questions.questionTextEn: The remainder when 7^100 is divided by 5 is:
questions.questionTextHi:
[Quantitative Aptitude • GATE CSE (CS) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
The remainder when 7^100 is divided by 5 is:
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (GATE CSE (CS) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
7 ≡ 2 (mod 5) and 2^4 = 16 ≡ 1 (mod 5). Hence 7^100 ≡ (2^4)^25 ≡ 1^25 = 1 (mod 5).

questions.questionTextEn: Consider a system that uses 5 bits for representing signed integers in 2's complement format. Two integers A and B are represented as A = 01010 and B = 11010. Which one of the following operations will result in an arithmetic overflow?
questions.questionTextHi:
[Digital Logic (2's Complement Overflow) • GATE CSE (CS) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
एक प्रणाली पर विचार करें जो उपयोग करती है 5 bits के लिए representing signed integers में 2's complement format. Two integers A and B are represented as A = 01010 and B = 11010. Which one of the following operations will result में an arithmetic overflow?
questions.explanationEn: In 5-bit 2's complement (representable range −16 to +15), A = 01010₂ = +10 and B = 11010₂ = −16 + 8 + 2 = −6. Computing A − B = 10 − (−6) = +16 exceeds the maximum positive value +15, resulting in a signed arithmetic overflow.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (GATE CSE (CS) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
In 5-bit 2's complement (representable range −16 to +15), A = 01010₂ = +10 and B = 11010₂ = −16 + 8 + 2 = −6. Computing A − B = 10 − (−6) = +16 exceeds the maximum positive value +15, resulting in a signed arithmetic overflow.

questions.questionTextEn: Let f : R → R be defined as f(x) = max{x, x³}. The set of all points in R where f(x) is NOT differentiable is:

questions.explanationEn: The curves y = x and y = x³ intersect where x³ − x = x(x − 1)(x + 1) = 0, i.e., at x = −1, 0, 1. At each of these three points the left and right derivatives of max{x, x³} differ (1 vs 3 at x = ±1; 0 vs 1 at x = 0), so f is non-differentiable at {−1, 0, 1}.

questions.questionTextEn: Suppose a TCP connection has a maximum segment size (MSS) of 1 KB and its congestion window (cwnd) is currently 32 KB when a timeout occurs. Under standard TCP Reno/Tahoe, the slow-start threshold (ssthresh) and the new cwnd immediately after the timeout become:

मान लीजिए कि a TCP connection has a maximum segment size (MSS) of 1 KB and its congestion window (cwnd) is currently 32 KB when a timeout occurs. Under standard TCP Reno/Tahoe, the slow-start threshold (ssthresh) and the new cwnd immediately after the timeout become:
optionsHi: विकल्प: ssthresh = 16 KB and cwnd = 1 KB
विकल्प: ssthresh = 16 KB and cwnd = 16 KB
विकल्प: ssthresh = 32 KB and cwnd = 1 KB
विकल्प: ssthresh = 8 KB and cwnd = 1 KB

प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
